title: [Dev/Master] Automation icon missing and small bug with rule temp target "is equal to" X mmol/l
symptom: Two bugs: 1) An automation rule with temp target 'is equal to' e.g. 8.0 does not trigger, while 'equal or greater than' does. 2) When a rule is marked for 'User action', the green gear icon does not appear in the overview screen, though it was visible in version 3.1.
cause: The thread does not establish a root cause for either bug. For the missing gear icon, a comment suggests that the gear icon was always used for User Action, so it adds no information, but no definitive cause is given.
fix: No fix is stated in the thread. A commit link is provided but no explanation of what it fixes. A comment suggests either reducing the button height or showing the logo of the first action, but this is a suggestion, not a confirmed fix.
evidence_quote: With User Action the logo was always the gear icon. Therefore it does not add any information. Either reduce the button height or show the logo of the first action.
